execute.description: Create proof attempts with foreign key and state check
execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE proof_attempts (
            id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES proof_records(id),
            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PROCESSING', 'UNKNOWN', 'FAILED', 'SUCCEEDED'))
          )

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AS result FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'proof_attempts'

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

label: Allow only one unresolved proof attempt

execute.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX proof_attempts_one_unresolved ON proof_attempts(record_id) WHERE status IN ('PROCESSING', 'UNKNOWN')

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AS result FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'index' AND name = 'proof_attempts_one_unresolved'
